summary.note: Winners = CPL below market avg AND SQL% above market avg. Losers = both metrics below avg or 0 wins at scale.

TH.note: Early-stage market — very limited wins, benchmarks not yet reliable

top_performers.why_it_works: Highest-volume ad in the dataset. Consistent evergreen BAU price promo — scalable because the offer is always relevant. Not flashy but reliable bottom-funnel performer.
Strong percentage-off promo anchor (55%) drives urgency. High SQL% AND high ThruPlay (124%) suggests people are watching to understand the offer. Best Win% in Q4 MY at scale.

MOST EFFICIENT ad in MY dataset. CPL RM47 (61% below benchmark) + CPWon RM721 (51% below benchmark). 'Choose Your Fighter' comparison format makes decision-making easy for the prospect — removes objection by comparing product tiers.

Highest CTR in Q4 MY at 3.95% — nearly 4x the benchmark. The 'Choose Your Fighter' format combined with the premium Falcon hardware drives massive scroll-stop. High Hook Rate (127%) confirms the opening frame works. CPWon higher but the scale potential is real.
Best CPWon in the Q3 MY set at RM885. Seasonal hook (Merdeka) + English language + video = highest Win% of all Q3 MY ads. Seasonality creates urgency that pushes undecided prospects to convert.

Lowest CPWon in Q3 MY at RM707. Comic/illustrated promo format with regional specificity (KL) performs well — the visual differentiation from standard product shots and location targeting likely drive qualified leads.

BEST performer across ALL markets. 45% SQL rate (nearly 2x PH benchmark) and CPWon RM630. 'All-In-One POS for F&B' messaging is hyper-relevant to the audience — vertical-specific (F&B) combined with the core value prop delivers precision targeting in the message itself.

Highest spend in PH Q4 and most scalable. CPL RM48 — lowest in PH at scale. Stop-motion unboxing format is visually engaging and unique vs standard talking-head or product demos. F&B context (restaurant setting) makes it relevant.

CPL RM41 — lowest in PH. Question-hook format ('How much is your profit?') with coffee shop context is highly specific and triggers self-reflection. Merchants who click are already thinking about their margins = higher intent. Limited spend but exceptional efficiency.

CTR 4.86% — highest in PH at scale. SQL% 38.3% — well above PH benchmark. The 'Choose Your Fighter' format works cross-market (also top in MY). Hook Rate 168% confirms the opening is extremely strong. The Falcon hardware elevates perceived value.
Best CPWon in Q3 PH at RM693. Low-spend but highly efficient. 'All-In-One POS PHP63' promo with merchant logos as social proof on static format.

Best video engagement metrics in TH by a large margin — Hold Rate and Hook Rate are 2-3x other TH ads. Analysis notes the 'blooper as hook' with high-paced editing and a familiar face (Krit) drives exceptional retention. No wins yet but TH is early-stage — the engagement signals point to creative direction.

bottom_performers.why_it_fails: RM15,667 spend for 1 win. SQL% only 15.87%. Generic unboxing without any promo, clear offer, or CTA. Chinese language narrows audience. Despite scalable spend, the creative drives no bottom-funnel intent.

bottom_performers.ad_name: EN_Choose Your Fighter + AI Intro + Speech_FnB
bottom_performers.why_it_fails: Zero wins at RM9,684 spend. SQL% 16.67%. The AI intro + speech format is too complex — multiple hooks competing (AI + Choose Your Fighter + Speech) without a single clear CTA or offer. Creative identity crisis.
SF (Salesforce) shows zero leads from this ad despite RM13,032 spend. Likely a tracking or landing page issue, but creative may have confused the intent signal. No data to diagnose further.

High SQL% (35%) but CPL RM287 — 2.4x the MY benchmark — makes this economically inefficient. 'Monthly plan' framing may be attracting window-shoppers who engage but don't convert to revenue. High spend makes this a costly mistake.

Zero SQLs and zero wins. 'Stress to Success' transformation narrative doesn't resonate as an acquisition message — too abstract, no concrete offer or feature hook. Confirmed poor in PH Q4 also (multiple variants tested, all underperformed).
Tested 4 variants (otp, BIR, CP, mixed) — all zero SQLs. Dead creative angle. Retire completely.

SQL% 50% but CPL RM456 — 4.6x PH benchmark. The ₱21,000 price point creates sticker shock at the top of funnel. High-intent qualified leads but the friction in the ad itself is too high. Should retest with softer price entry.

CTR appears anomalous (49% reported — likely data formatting issue). Only 1 lead at CPL RM374. The 'Choose Your Fighter' format that works in MY/PH is not yet adapted for Thai market — may need Thai language + local hardware context.

winning_elements.evidence: MY Q4: D3 CYF (CPL RM47, CPWon RM721), Falcon CYF (CTR 3.95%); PH Q4: Falcon CYF (CTR 4.86%, SQL% 38.3%)
winning_elements.mechanism: Side-by-side hardware comparison makes the buying decision easy and removes objections. Visual 'fighter' framing is gamified and engaging.

winning_elements.evidence: PH: Allinonepos_Fnb = SQL% 45%, CPWon RM630 vs. generic All-In-One = SQL% lower. MY: FnB-labelled unboxing variants outperform generic.
winning_elements.mechanism: When the ad says 'for restaurants' / 'for F&B', restaurant owners self-select as high-intent leads. Generic messaging attracts more noise.

winning_elements.evidence: MY Q4: BAU Promo CPL RM64 at RM62,988 spend; 55% Promo V2 SQL% 33.5%; PH Q3: PHP63 promo drives all top performers
winning_elements.mechanism: Concrete price reduces cognitive load. Merchants comparing costs need a specific number to anchor on. % discount creates urgency.

winning_elements.evidence: PH Q4: howmuchisyourprofit_coffee CPL RM41 (lowest PH); MY Q3: brand language 'You're paying how much in delivery fees?'
winning_elements.mechanism: Questions trigger self-audit. Merchants calculating their own costs/losses are already in the buying mindset before they click.

winning_elements.evidence: MY Q3: Split-screen + promo = consistent SQL% above avg. BAU D3 Mini Split Screen Q4: CPL RM116, SQL% 23.7%
winning_elements.mechanism: Split screen allows side-by-side comparison — product visual on one side, offer/price on the other. Both register simultaneously without fighting for attention.

winning_elements.evidence: MY Q3: EN_Merdeka Promo CPWon RM885; CN_Raya Promo SQL% 33.65%; CN/MS Merdeka variants all outperform non-seasonal equivalents
winning_elements.mechanism: Seasonal context creates natural deadline. When paired with product + price, it converts the seasonal urgency into purchase intent.

winning_elements.evidence: PH Q4: unboxingrestaurant_stopmotion_falcon = RM37k spend, CPL RM48 (lowest large-spend PH)
winning_elements.mechanism: Stop-motion is visually distinct in the feed — breaks pattern recognition and forces a second look. Uniqueness = engagement.

winning_elements.evidence: TH Q3: Openshopwith_StoreHub = Hold Rate 0.56%, Hook Rate 0.50%, ThruPlay 0.44% — all 2-3x other TH ads
winning_elements.mechanism: Unexpected/funny opening disrupts scroll habit. In TH market where trust is still being built, entertainment-first hook lowers barriers.

winning_elements.evidence: MY Q3 final takeaway: English creatives achieve highest Win%. EN_Merdeka CPWon RM885, EN_Comic Promo CPWon RM707.
winning_elements.mechanism: English-speaking MY prospects may skew toward more tech-savvy, decision-ready business owners. Higher quality signal.

winning_elements.evidence: PH Q3: '#1 POS System' with promo outperforms '#1 POS' with logos. MY Q3: Several high-performers include 'No. 1 POS System' tag.
winning_elements.mechanism: Authority claim + tangible offer = trust + action. The authority positioning reduces risk perception; the offer creates urgency.

losing_elements.element: Testimonials / merchant quotes as primary creative
losing_elements.evidence: PH Q3: productcentrictestimonial high CPWon RM6,546; PH Q3 final: 'testimonials didn't scale — despite decent engagement, failed to get SQLs'; MY Q4: Back Alley Pasta VP1 Testimonial CPWon RM1,075 at low scale
losing_elements.rule: Testimonials work as supporting elements (alongside offer/hardware) but NOT as the lead hook. Retire testimonial-only ads.

losing_elements.element: Generic unboxing without offer or CTA
losing_elements.evidence: MY Q3: CN_D3 Mini Unboxing CPWon RM15,667 (1 win RM15k spend); MY Q3 final: 'unboxing without promo or clear CTA repeatedly underperform'
losing_elements.rule: Never run plain unboxing. Always pair with promo, comparison, or clear next-step CTA.

losing_elements.evidence: PH Q3 + Q4: StressToSuccess tested in 5+ variants across all segments, 0 SQLs consistently
losing_elements.rule: RETIRE this creative angle in PH permanently. Do not test in MY or TH.

losing_elements.evidence: MY Q3: EN_Choose Your Fighter + AI Intro + Speech = RM9,684 spend, 0 wins
losing_elements.rule: One hook per ad. Never stack AI intro + product + comparison. Pick one angle.

losing_elements.element: Merchant logos as social proof (without offer)
losing_elements.evidence: PH Q3: allinoneposphp63_fnb_logos (logos version) = CPWon RM2,957 vs logos_relaunch (with promo) = CPWon RM693. PH Q3 final: 'logos underperform vs #1 POS + promo'
losing_elements.rule: Logo walls are weak standalone social proof. Use only as secondary element alongside promo or #1 POS claim.

losing_elements.element: Price as primary hook without hardware/product visual
losing_elements.evidence: MY Q3 final: 'promo-only ads without hardware context show High CPL & CPSQL'
losing_elements.rule: Never run price-only ads. Price must be paired with hardware or product visual.

MY.best_language: English (highest Win%), Chinese (highest SQL%), Malay (scalable volume)
scale_leaders: BAU Non Seasonal Promo (CPL RM141, 393 leads)
MY.efficiency_leader: D3 Choose Your Fighter (CPL RM47, CPWon RM721)
key_gaps: BTC-style authentic merchant video untested as paid

PH.winning_formula: All-In-One POS + F&B vertical specificity + price anchor (PHP63) + hardware visual
key_gaps: Question hooks (howmuchisyourprofit) tested at tiny spend — huge scale opportunity
Choose Your Fighter needs more variants at scale

TH.status: Early stage — low volume, high CPL, no wins yet. Building creative learnings.
TH.strongest_signal: Openshopwith_StoreHub blooper hook = best video engagement metrics in market. This is the creative direction to double down on.
TH.biggest_gap: Everything. Thai-specific pain-point hooks, retail vertical, Choose Your Fighter in Thai, eCommerce commission comparison — all untested.
TH.recommendation: Prioritise engagement-first creative (entertaining, native-feel, personality-driven) before efficiency. Build brand awareness before optimising for lead cost.

cross_market_insights.insight: Choose Your Fighter is a universal format — works in MY and PH with high CTR and SQL%. Must be adapted and scaled in TH.
cross_market_insights.action: Create Thai-language CYF variant with Krit (TH local personality) as host

cross_market_insights.insight: F&B vertical specificity improves SQL% significantly in PH. Likely applies to MY too but under-tested.
cross_market_insights.action: Create F&B-specific variants of top MY performers (BAU Promo, 55% Off) with explicit F&B context

cross_market_insights.insight: 'How much is your profit/delivery fee?' question hook delivers lowest CPL in PH. Never tested in MY or TH.
cross_market_insights.action: Adapt question hooks for MY (Malay, Chinese, English) with local market context (Grab delivery fees)

cross_market_insights.insight: Plain testimonial content fails as acquisition creative across all markets tested.
cross_market_insights.action: Use testimonials only as supporting elements (quote + offer + hardware) — never as primary creative hook

cross_market_insights.insight: Stop-motion and unexpected visual formats outperform standard talking-head and product shots.
cross_market_insights.action: Commission stop-motion and/or blooper-style creatives for MY and TH (already in PH)

recommendations: SCALE: Increase budget on BAU Promo (MY), Allinonepos_P63 (PH), and ChooseYourFighter_Falcon (PH) — these have proven efficiency with room to scale.
CREATE: F&B vertical-specific variants of top MY performers — e.g., '55% Off — Built for F&B Restaurants'.
CREATE: Question-hook ads in MY — adapt 'How much are you paying in delivery fees?' for MY market in all 3 languages.
CREATE: Retail vertical ads in MY and PH — currently 90%+ of creative tests are F&B focused; retail owners are an underserved audience.
CREATE: Stop-motion style creative for MY — adapt the PH stop-motion unboxing format for D3/Falcon in a MY restaurant setting.
CREATE: TH Choose Your Fighter variant in Thai language with local personality.
RETIRE: All StressToSuccess variants in PH. All generic unboxing videos without offer/CTA. All testimonial-only formats.
TEST: eInvoicing urgency angle in MY — regulatory deadline creates natural CTA hook (not yet tested at all).
TEST: '#1 POS + F&B vertical + price' combination in MY (works well in PH, not yet tried in MY).
MONITOR: BAU Promo and Allinonepos_P63 for CTR fatigue — both at high spend levels.
